Political Maneuvering: MP Resignations and Party Mergers Reported

Several Indian political parties are experiencing internal shifts and realignments. Trinamool Congress MP Koel Mallick has resigned from the Rajya Sabha, with reports of her meeting a BJP leader. Concurrently, the Lok Sabha Speaker has approved the merger of six MPs from Uddhav Thackeray's Shiv Sena faction with the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena. Additionally, three former TMC MPs have been elected to the Rajya Sabha as BJP nominees.
